themes.name: Blossom
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: A phone-first Material You look in soft pink over violet-black, with very round corners, a mesh glow and Nunito. Home opens on a featured card that pairs the cover with the title, score and pill actions, then rounded poster rows and card-style resume stills. The series page shows chips for score, format, episodes and season with a thumbnail episode list. Desktop uses the same palette with a wider banner.

themes.name: Cobalt
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: A tracker-style navy canvas with a sky-blue accent and square corners. The stock featured banner keeps its rank badge, poster rows carry grey captions, and the series page stacks a muted facts panel — format, episodes, season, studio, source — beside the cover, with episodes in a still grid.

themes.name: Coral
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: A phone-first look in coral red on deep navy with rounded cards. Home leads with a spotlight card — cover on the left, title, genres and a coral Watch button on the right — then tight poster rows. The series page paints the title and Play over the artwork with an episode list underneath. Desktop gets a wide spotlight banner with the same palette.

themes.name: Daylight
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: The catalog’s light theme. A warm paper canvas, serif type and a coral accent. Top navigation, a featured backdrop with a paper caption card and an ink-dark Watch button, generously rounded poster rows with titles and years, and a split series page with a right-hand episode rail.

themes.name: Ember
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: A warm crimson living-room palette: tinted cards, a red accent, landscape resume art and the same split episode rail as Tidal.

themes.name: Halo
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: Frosted chrome: a top navigation bar, aurora glass, large landscape tiles and quiet poster titles. The seekbar uses the brand accent.

themes.name: Kindling
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: Cool gray canvas, rose accent, Nunito. Home opens on a rotating full-bleed featured banner with Watch Now and View Details, then horizontal poster rows. The series page uses icon facts, an overlapping cover, and a right-hand rail with one short episode tile per row — square still on the left, title and synopsis on the right, grow-on-hover. Phones get a shorter banner, tighter rows and a stacked series page with the same episode tiles.

themes.name: Lavender
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: A phone-first Material look: a periwinkle accent on soft violet-black, large rounded corners and tonal buttons. Home opens on a featured card with pill actions, then small rounded poster rows and wide resume cards. The series page stacks a compact cover, chips and a thumbnail episode list. Desktop keeps the same palette with a wider featured banner.

themes.name: Ledger
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: Near-black media-server look with a violet accent. Home uses a continue-watching banner, large 16:9 resume stills, then poster carousels beside an icon sidebar. The series page is a tall fluid banner, overlapping cover on the left, metadata, and a grid of episode stills below.

themes.name: Nebula
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: A deep violet-navy canvas with a soft mesh glow and a bright violet accent. Compact icon rail, a wide featured backdrop with pill actions, rounded poster rows with quiet titles, and a full-bleed series page whose episodes run as a thumbnail list beneath the artwork.

themes.name: Onyx
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: A phone-first true-black streaming look with an electric blue accent. Home opens on a tall centred featured card with white Play and Info buttons, then dense caption-free poster rows and small resume stills. The series page stacks a short banner, cover and a thumbnail episode list. Desktop keeps the black canvas with a wide featured backdrop.

themes.name: Orchid
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: A violet living-room palette: cool-black canvas, purple accent, landscape resume cards and a split series page. Pair with true black on OLED.

themes.name: Prism
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: Cinematic glass. A tall rotating backdrop with a frosted caption card and a cyan halo, a top navigation bar, large rounded poster rails, wide resume stills with glass captions, and a full-bleed series page with an episode carousel of rounded stills.

themes.name: Tangerine
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: Streaming-service orange on charcoal with square corners. A compact top bar, a tall featured backdrop with a bold Start Watching button, tight poster rows, and a stacked series page whose episodes are a grid of 16:9 stills with numbered titles.

themes.name: Tidal
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: Living-room layout: a full-bleed featured backdrop with a large title, compact top navigation, and poster rows with titles and years. The series page paints Play, title, synopsis and chips directly on the artwork. Episodes sit below as wide stills.
